notes:
• Backup player (mpv): video your TV can't decode, like 10-bit H.264 anime or VC-1, now plays instead of being skipped
• FLAC audio always plays through ValFlix's own decoder (fixes playback stopping a few minutes in on some TVs)
• If the sound fails mid-play, ValFlix switches audio decoder and carries on from the same spot
• AV1 up to 1080p now plays on devices without hardware AV1 (like the SHIELD), with a new, faster decoder
• 4K AV1 and 10-bit H.264 releases your device can't play are ranked last and marked
• New settings in Sources & Playback: Player engine and Audio decoders
• Updated playback engine (Media3 1.9)
